items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I did a lot of things with Gene Krupa where they used most of the Condon Band

ctx.x: And, he never did go back - did he?

No he never no - no. But, that was one of the things I think some of the records that were made in that period of time, you know, I did a lot of things with Jack Teagarden - you know - such wonderful things; I did a lot of things with Gene Krupa where they used most of the Condon Band and that kind of stuff. And, Eddie was usually in on all that as well - you know - playing his guitar.
This would be a good opportunity to say in making those records was Condon basically the musical director?
